traps.why: You handed over the magnesium alkoxide. Add H₃O⁺ to protonate it to the alcohol.
Acid before the carbonyl partner just protonates the Grignard: you get the alkane and no new C–C bond. Partner first, then H₃O⁺.

explanation: The Grignard carbon adds to the aldehyde carbonyl from either face; after H₃O⁺ you get a racemic 2° alcohol.
tip: Aldehyde partner → 2° alcohol, new stereocenter → racemic.
